description: This file contains CMake configuration code to set up Vulkan dependencies for different platforms (Android and others), including conditional logic for finding Vulkan or setting up Vulkan wrapper sources.

methods.name: message()
methods.description: Displays messages during CMake configuration, either status or fatal error messages.

methods.name: find_package()
methods.description: Attempts to locate the Vulkan package on the system.

methods.name: add_library()
methods.description: Defines a new library target, in this case VulkanWrapper, which includes specified source files.

methods.name: target_include_directories()
methods.description: Sets include directories for the VulkanWrapper target, marked as PUBLIC.

methods.name: target_link_libraries()
methods.description: Links VulkanWrapper against system libraries like dl.

methods.name: list(APPEND ...)
methods.description: Appends items to CMake list variables such as Vulkan_INCLUDES and Vulkan_LIBS.

methods.name: set()
methods.description: Sets CMake variables, including include/search paths and flags.

methods.name: string(APPEND ...)
methods.description: Appends strings to existing variables, e.g., adding compilation flags.
